title: Verification report
description: Per-item verification report emitted by the verification skill. Pure function output: one claim entry per atomic assertion in the source item, plus a rolled-up overall_verdict. See .claude/skills/verification/reference/verifier-prompt.md for the producing protocol and docs/plans/session-2-verification-skill.md for the six divergences from PRD §11.1.

item_source_hash.description: Mirrors item.source_hash at the moment of verification. Must match.

verifier_version.description: Static 'v1' for this skill pack; bump on breaking prompt changes.

overall_verdict.description: Rollup. Rules (in order): halt_stale if freshness fails; fail if any claim is contradicted or unsupported; pass_with_caveats if any claim is partially_supported or unverifiable without the above; pass_clean if every claim is supported.

sources_reached.description: One entry per source index the verifier attempted to use. `ok` means raw text was present in sources_map; other values indicate the caller could not supply that source.

claims.description: Empty array when overall_verdict = halt_stale; otherwise one entry per atomic claim enumerated from the item. Synthesis claims produce TWO entries: <path>.item_atom and <path>.join_atom.

claim_id.description: Stable json-path into the source item (e.g. 'zoning.staff_recommendation', 'location.address', 'sources[2].url'), or synthetic 'body.claim[N]' for body-sourced claims, or '<base>.item_atom' / '<base>.join_atom' for split synthesis claims, or 'meta.payload_issue' for diagnostic editorial claims on malformed payloads.

value.description: For structural / extracted claims, the value asserted by the item. Null otherwise.

raw_passage.description: For extracted claims, the raw_passage from the upstream {value, confidence, raw_passage} triple. Null otherwise.

evidence.description: Non-null for every verdict except unverifiable.

note.description: Required for every verdict other than supported. One sentence.
